description: This file defines a HealthService class in a Java Spring application that provides health check endpoints for the application and its database. It checks the application's basic health status and the connectivity/status of the database using a DataSource.

classes.name: HealthService
classes.description: A Spring @Service component that provides health check methods for overall service health and database connectivity.

methods.name: HealthService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HealthService with a DataSource.

methods.name: checkServiceHealth
methods.description: Performs a minimal check to determine if the application is up. Currently, it always returns UP.

methods.name: checkDatabaseHealth
methods.description: Attempts to connect to the database and validate the connection. Reports UP if successful, otherwise reports DOWN with error details.
